card.name: Words linking assay methods and drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right after a drug or analyte name, introducing a lab method or a co-listed drug, plus the 'CH' start of trial and brand names like CHARM and CHOLBAM.

modes.label: Lab method link
modes.description: A linking word such as by, with, or using that introduces the assay or instrument after a measured substance.
modes.example: measuring urinary normetanephrine<< by>> liquid chromatography with electrochemical detection.

modes.label: Comma after a drug name
modes.description: A comma after a drug name in a list of tested or affected drugs.
modes.example: a subcutaneous dose of 0.3 mg/kg of RELISTOR did not significantly affect the metabolism of dextromethorphan<<,>> a CYP2D6 substrate.

modes.label: CH at the start of a name
modes.description: The opening 'CH' of a trial or brand name, such as CHARM or CHOLBAM.
